name: Sample Snapjaw Shell
summary: Across the Barrens, snapjaw shells hold a spark of life from freshwater oases. Tauren druids send them across the Great Sea to aid Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: A Spark of Oasis Life
sections.body: Snapjaws thrive in the Barrens' strange, lush oases. Their durable shells hold a faint glow and pulse with energy long after the creature is gone. Tauren druids watch the land change swiftly, and see in these shells a resilient spark of Kalimdor's wilderness. Their vigor shows how life can flourish even in harsh, arid lands.

sections.title: Healing Distant Lands
sections.body: Tauren naturalists send couriers across the sea with shells for Mura Runetotem at the Sepulcher. She is stationed in Silverpine Forest's blighted expanses, seeking ways to help the Forsaken heal the northlands. Mura studies the life-force held in snapjaw armor, hoping it can show what will renew an ailing forest and bring growth back to dying soil.

faq.q: What makes this snapjaw shell special?
faq.answer: A Sample Snapjaw Shell keeps a faint glow and pulse of life long after collection. It comes from snapjaws around the Barrens' strange freshwater oases, where natural energies run unusually high.
Mura Runetotem, a tauren druid, needs the shell at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. She seeks ways to help the Forsaken heal dying lands.

faq.q: Why send a Barrens shell all the way to Silverpine?
faq.answer: Silverpine's woodland is blighted and ailing, while life has surged at the Barrens oases and endured. Druids hope the vitality in Kalimdor's beasts can teach them how to heal Lordaeron's damaged soil.

faq.q: Is the shell dangerous or tainted?
faq.answer: No. The shell carries pure vitality, not dark magic. Druids see the lingering energy amid the Barrens' sudden growth as natural resilience worth cultivating.

angles.text: For druids of the Cenarion Circle, studying oasis snapjaws teaches how life perseveres and how blighted ground might be healed.
As a tauren, you can see this shell's journey as a commitment to the Earth Mother. Your people carry aid and natural healing across the sea, even to their undead allies.
